reply.text:
Getting the flu isn't a failure on your part, and a streak is only a count. Rest while you were sick was the right call, and it doesn't undo any of the work you've built.

Good to have you back. We start from today. Ease in with a session or two at a lighter load than you left off, keep the rest of the week simple, and let your energy tell you when to build back up. Once you feel fully recovered, the streak starts counting again with your next session.

If you're still coughing or feeling run down, check with a doctor before pushing hard. When you're ready, I can set up today's session or start your next workout.
